issues.title: Settled unconfirmed save remains displayed as actively saving
issues.area: Selected product editor recovery status and Shopify Save Bar
issues.evidenceLevel: native screenshot plus source-confirmed state mapping
issues.actual: After the original Retry failed, the native screen shows the same 'Your changes could not be confirmed. Retry the original request before saving different changes.' message in both the top error banner and the blue editor notice. The Shopify header Save Bar still shows a loading spinner although the request has settled. Source review confirms saveDraft clears writeBusy in finally, but AdminSaveBar receives saving={writeBusy || adapter.pending()}, and adapter.pending() stays true while exact unresolved custody is retained. The editor's save catch also sets a transient storage-save-failed notice, using the same realSaveFailed translation as the container's persistent retry banner.
issues.expected: Once a request settles, the save bar stops indicating an active write while the unresolved command remains locked for exact Retry. Show one persistent recovery message, keep unrelated saves/discard blocked, and only show active loading while a save or retry request is actually in flight.
issues.closure: Replay first-save unknown result plus one failed exact Retry. Preserve unresolved custody and all write gates; show a stopped Save Bar after each settled response, active loading only while the original request/retry is in flight, and one recovery message with the Retry action. The minimal state correction is to drive loading from in-flight work rather than adapter.pending(); if retry should animate the Save Bar, expose a separate retrying state. Suppress the duplicate production editor notice while the container owns the persistent recovery banner. Do not clear or replace the original command to make the UI appear settled.
